test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: D, E, F, G, H, J and K were sitting in a straight row, facing north. J was exactly between H and E. Only K was to the right of F. Only G was to the left of D. H was to the immediate left of F. Who was to the immediate right of D?
solution: Given: D, E, F, G, H, J and K were sitting in a straight row, facing north. 1) Only K was to the right of F. 2) Only G was to the left of D. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1810ff943b6675c5c961c01b8afc3981bdaf52fa9613857c8aed6b683e68c255.png]
